CustomField.description: Number of drivers which are missing for this round. Uses round schedule field.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(TEXT(Round_Schedule__c) = "4 by 2", TEXT(Round_Status__c) = "Active", Num_Days__c > 2), IF(ISBLANK(Default_Driver__c), 1, 0) + IF(AND(TEXT(Round_Schedule__c) = "4 by 2", ISBLANK(X2nd_Driver__c)), 0.5, 0), NULL )
CustomField.label: Num Missing Drivers
